requirements.requirement: Tidy storage for sewing supplies (compartmented organizer)
requirements.evidence: 3-cell build: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments, full depth), bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments), bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-half-div3 (3 shallow compartments) — 8 compartments total for sorting threads, scissors, needles, buttons, tape etc.
piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full with capOpenFaces (12 solid caps) and lockJoints (3 jointBolts); check_build meshClash clear

finish.summary: Compact 3-hex sewing caddy with 8 compartments across two full-depth bins and one half-depth bin for small notions. Props staging was attempted but server busy prevented placement; the compartmented geometry itself provides tidy sewing storage.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
